text:
The passages propose several complementary approaches:

- **Abstain when uncertain.** An image classifier could withhold an output it is uncertain about, rather than give a potentially unreliable classification. (https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/dYHiMeSdLrrX3cy4a/embedding-safety-in-ml-development) For unfamiliar images, another proposal is to ask a human for clarification or explicitly indicate uncertainty. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hWb09uq6Zlk)

- **Require agreement among different kinds of classifiers.** A conservative system could classify an image only when two or more—or three or more—different types of classifiers agree, making agreement a condition for answering. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hWb09uq6Zlk)

- **Train classifiers to use relevant features rather than incidental backgrounds.** For example, a dumbbell classifier should focus on the dumbbell itself, not arms, blank space, or other background patterns; this is proposed to address failures on previously unseen images. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hWb09uq6Zlk)

- **Test and train against perturbations and attacks.** Robustness can be tested and improved by perturbing training images and further training on those examples. (https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/CRMhhnKs7bymY4kbb/my-thoughts-on-the-ml-safety-course) Running adversarial attacks against the system itself is also proposed as a way to identify which classifiers remain stable under particular attacks. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hWb09uq6Zlk)

- **Detect anomalies and warn operators.** Anomaly detectors can flag potential hazards—including unfamiliar images that a classifier might otherwise classify confidently—so human operators can reduce their exposure to those hazards. (https://www.alignmentforum.org/posts/AwMb7C72etphiRvah/unsolved-ml-safety-problems)

- **Use certified defenses against localized malicious alterations.** One proposal combines vision transformers with *derandomized smoothing*: the transformers’ token-based attention handles the ablated images used by the defense, enabling improved provable robustness against adversarial patches—arbitrary changes within a small, contiguous image region. These guarantees concern that specified class of alterations, not every possible attack. (https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.07719)
